notes.title: Version 2.2.4 is Live
notes.content: Angel is tired of endless-running. You're now in control!

notes.title: Version 2.1 is live!
notes.content:
This update is focused on making the game more challenging, rewarding both player's skill and optimal character building.

Stronger monsters and NPCs will now follow the player. However, player's running speed has been slightly increased, to better avoid projectiles and collisions with stronger foes. You'll find using the fast-running ability very useful (i.e. using RT on a game controller).

Some directional spells (like Fireball) have been changed to target enemies based on the current running direction, giving you more control over the spell. We've also removed some input lag from casting to improve your control over the timing of spells.

To better accommodate these changes, we've redesigned the engine to work with different frame rates, allowing the game to run at native refresh rate of your monitor. For most users, the game will be running at 60 fps.

Thank you for playing Ritual!

notes.title: Version 2.0 is live!
notes.content:
[b]You can now fully control your movement![/b]

Run wherever you want! Speed up! Slow down!
Use your newfound ability to avoid danger and hunt down your prey.

Version 2.0 has been completely reworked based on your feedback.
Ritual is now faster, with streamlined combat and more frenetic on-screen chaos!

The game is best played with a [b]game controller[/b]; mouse and keyboard is also supported.

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Version 1.0.17 is live!
notes.content:
It is now possible to [b]cast most spells during dagger attacks[/b], and stabbing enemies no longer interrupts spells with duration. This makes combat much more fluid and results in even wilder onscreen chaos!

We've added [b]more mana[/b] into the world in several ways - all higher forms of mana crystals now yield +25% and +33% more mana. There's now much more mana to be found in smashed Mana Pods and destructible objects. There's also a higher chance to spawn a Spell Orb from smashed amphorae.

Several Spells and Skills have been boosted, most notably Critical Strike and Black Seals, Shattering Ram and Force Shield. Try getting the Ice Wizard achievement now, it's very satisfying!

This update also brings various clarifications of base systems to the early stages of the game. Level Up now briefly displays our current Power Level number and [b]dangerous enemies[/b] display flashing [b]red aura[/b] in addition to their Strength number. 

Thank you for playing!
